name: Southsea Treasure
summary: Southsea Treasure lies aboard a pirate ship south of Ratchet, where Wrenix the Wretched seeks the hoard. The Tide Razor's lowest hold sits beneath the Southsea Freebooters' training ground.

sections.title: A Deadly Heist
sections.body:
The Tide Razor lies anchored along the Merchant Coast south of Ratchet. The Southsea Freebooters use it as a forward base and training ground. Their plunder, called the Southsea Treasure, waits in the lowest hold.

Wrenix the Wretched, a goblin scoundrel in Ratchet, sets the theft as a test for aspiring pickpockets. He says the last five operatives sent after the chest came back in pieces. Alert pirates guard the ship, and a fierce creature watches the hold.

sections.title: Polly's Keepsake
sections.body:
Polly guards the Southsea Treasure in the hold. Thieves who evade the pirate trainers and pick the chest's lock find the hostile parrot instead of loose treasure.

Wrenix's E.C.A.C. device can help overcome Polly. Only then can the treasure be taken from the hold and brought back to Ratchet intact.

faq.q: Where is the Southsea Treasure located?
faq.answer: The Southsea Treasure is aboard the Tide Razor, anchored along the coast south of Ratchet in the Barrens. It lies in the lowest hold beneath the pirates' training quarters.
Wrenix the Wretched, a goblin in Ratchet, wants the Southsea Treasure. He hires covert operatives to enter the ship and recover it for him.

faq.q: Why is the chest empty when picked?
aliases: why isn't the treasure in the box
faq.answer: Polly guards the Southsea Treasure inside the hold. Picking the chest's lock brings the vicious parrot into the fight; defeating Polly yields the treasure.

faq.q: What is an E.C.A.C. and why is it needed?
faq.answer: Wrenix the Wretched provides the E.C.A.C., an experimental goblin device meant to weaken unusually fierce airborne threats. He intends it for Polly, the lethal guardian parrot in the ship's hold.

faq.q: What do the Southsea Freebooters use the ship for?
faq.answer: The Tide Razor is a base and thieves' den for the Southsea Freebooters. On its second level, practice lockboxes give the crew a place to train their cutpurses.

angles.text: As a developing rogue, recovering the Southsea Treasure offers lockpicking practice and an introduction to the Shattered Hand, a shadowy syndicate.
As a member of the Horde, disrupting the Southsea Freebooters' stash can help local authorities. The pirates harass trade around the Barrens and the Port of Ratchet.
